name: QES
recent: QES Group Berhad 于2026年9月完成向 Ray Tech Singapore 私募配售10%新股，并宣布以约1700万令吉收购新加坡两间办公室单位。2026年11月公布季度业绩，净利同比大幅增长。
notable: 完成向 Ray Tech Singapore 发行83,276,260股新股（占10%），每股RM0.53。
拟以547万新元（约1749万令吉）收购新加坡两间办公室单位。
2026年9月11日召开特别股东大会，通过上述私募配售议案。
risks: 私募配售新股可能摊薄现有股东持股比例。
多名风险委员会及审计委员会成员变动。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收7883.5万令吉，环比增长35.3%，同比增长1.9%；净利700.9万令吉，环比增长89.5%，同比增长58.2%；净利率8.9%，高于上季度的6.3%。

recent_en: QES Group Berhad completed a 10% private placement to Ray Tech Singapore in September 2026 and announced the acquisition of two office units in Singapore for about RM17 million. It reported quarterly results in November 2026 with a significant year-on-year profit increase.
notable_en: Completed issuance of 83,276,260 new shares (10%) to Ray Tech Singapore at RM0.53 per share.
Proposed acquisition of two office units in Singapore for SGD5.47 million (about RM17.49 million).
Held an EGM on 11 September 2026 where the private placement resolution was passed.
risks_en: The private placement may dilute existing shareholders' shareholding.
Several changes in the Risk Committee and Audit Committee members.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM78.835 million, up 35.3% QoQ and 1.9% YoY; net income was RM7.009 million, up 89.5% QoQ and 58.2% YoY; net margin was 8.9%, higher than 6.3% in the previous quarter.
